def _b_t2_exercise(monkeypatch, directory, backend, observed, callback):
    from cloud_edge_robot_arm.repositories.event_autonomy import InMemoryEventAutonomyRepository
    from cloud_edge_robot_arm.simulation_runtime import operational_lease
    from cloud_edge_robot_arm.simulation_runtime.sqlite_repository import SQLiteSimulationJobRepository
    from tests.test_visual_worker_factory import software_factory

    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    outcomes, errors, reads = [], [], {}
    received = None
    events = None

    def episode(worker, repo, job, source_root):
        runtime = received[0][3].worker_runtime
        session = worker._operational_lease_session
        assert type(repo) is SQLiteSimulationJobRepository
        assert runtime.source.event_repository is events
        assert runtime._operational_owner is not None and session is not None
        for thread, kind in ((session._broker, "broker_thread"),
                             (getattr(worker, "_heartbeat_thread", None), "heartbeat_thread")):
            if thread is not None:
                record = observed.add(thread, kind)
                record["initialized"] = True
        try:
            outcomes.append(callback(runtime, session, worker, repo, job, events, reads, observed))
        except BaseException as error:
            errors.append(error)
            raise

    with monkeypatch.context() as scoped:
        data = software_factory(scoped, directory, during_episode=episode)
        repo, job, worker, calls, received, _, original_events = data
        events = original_events
        if backend == "memory":
            original_events.close()
            events = InMemoryEventAutonomyRepository()
            worker.visual_event_repository = events
        worker.operational_time_mode = "LOCAL_TEMPORAL_PUBLICATION_V1"
        try:
            # All independent connections exist BEFORE any tested job view/event lock.
            reads["job"] = sqlite3.connect(repo.database_path)
            reads["job"].row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            if backend == "sqlite":
                reads["event"] = sqlite3.connect(events.path)
                reads["event"].row_factory = sqlite3.Row
            assert worker.poll_once()
            if errors:
                raise errors[0]
            assert len(outcomes) == 1, repo.get_job(job.job_id).error_message
            assert calls.count("episode") == 1
            return outcomes[0]
        finally:
            observed.wait_observer = None
            for event in observed.release_events:
                event.set()
            session = getattr(worker, "_operational_lease_session", None)
            if session is not None and not session._closed:
                operational_lease._close_worker_lease_session(session, reason="T2-exercise-finally")
            events.close()
            for connection in reads.values():
                connection.close()

def _b_t3_supervision(runtime, data, key, observed):
    from decimal import Decimal
    from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.supervision import SupervisionContext, SupervisionDecision

    period, _ = runtime._runtime_option_sources()
    configuration = _b_t2_plain(runtime._job_configuration())
    persisted_ms = configuration["draft"]["parameter_overrides"]["supervision_period_ms"]
    assert type(persisted_ms) in (int, float) and persisted_ms == 300
    assert type(period) in (int, float) and period == persisted_ms / 1000 == 0.3
    period_decimal = Decimal(str(persisted_ms)) * Decimal(1_000_000)
    assert period_decimal.is_finite() and period_decimal > 0
    assert period_decimal == period_decimal.to_integral_value()
    period_ns = int(period_decimal)
    assert period_ns == 300_000_000
    registered = runtime.initialize_supervision(period, data["robot"])
    assert registered.to_payload()["schema_version"] == "visual.supervision.record.local.v1"
    assert registered.definition.to_payload()["payload"]["supervision_period_s"] == period
    owner = runtime._operational_owner
    assert owner is not None and owner.task_origin is not None and owner.task_origin_token is not None
    matches = [(clock, counter) for clock, counter, domain_kind in observed.clocks
               if clock is owner._clock and domain_kind == "D_app"]
    assert len(matches) == 1
    clock, counter = matches[0]
    owner_thread, owner_native_thread = threading.get_ident(), threading.get_native_id()
    assert owner_thread == clock.domain.owner_thread_id == owner._startup.thread_id
    assert owner_native_thread == clock.domain.owner_native_thread_id
    origin, origin_token, domain = owner.task_origin, owner.task_origin_token, clock.domain
    origin_snapshot = _b_t2_plain(origin)
    token_snapshot = _b_t2_plain(origin_token)
    original_time = copy.deepcopy(runtime.bootstrap.to_payload()["original_time"])
    hard_bounds = [{"source_id": hard.source_id, "deadline_ns": hard.deadline.deadline_ns,
                    "budget_ns": hard.deadline.budget_ns, "origin": _b_t2_plain(hard.deadline.origin)}
                   for hard in owner._hard]
    assert hard_bounds and all(hard["origin"] == origin_snapshot for hard in hard_bounds)
    budget_before = _b_t2_plain(runtime.verification_state)
    before_counter_ns = counter.now
    current_before = clock.read_current(after=origin_token)
    cursor = 1
    due_ns = origin.upper_ns + cursor * period_ns
    target_ns = max(before_counter_ns, due_ns)
    assert type(before_counter_ns) is int and type(target_ns) is int and 0 <= before_counter_ns <= target_ns
    assert all(target_ns < hard["deadline_ns"] for hard in hard_bounds)
    counter.now = target_ns
    current_after = clock.read_current(after=origin_token)
    after_counter_ns = counter.now
    assert after_counter_ns == target_ns and before_counter_ns <= after_counter_ns
    assert current_after.lower_ns >= due_ns
    assert all(current_after.upper_ns < hard["deadline_ns"] for hard in hard_bounds)
    assert clock.domain == domain and owner.task_origin is origin and owner.task_origin_token is origin_token
    assert _b_t2_plain(owner.task_origin) == origin_snapshot
    assert _b_t2_plain(owner.task_origin_token) == token_snapshot
    assert runtime.bootstrap.to_payload()["original_time"] == original_time
    assert [{"source_id": hard.source_id, "deadline_ns": hard.deadline.deadline_ns,
             "budget_ns": hard.deadline.budget_ns, "origin": _b_t2_plain(hard.deadline.origin)}
            for hard in owner._hard] == hard_bounds
    assert _b_t2_plain(runtime._job_configuration()) == configuration
    assert _b_t2_plain(runtime.verification_state) == budget_before
    runtime.check_active(data["robot"])
    cadence = {
        "period_source": {"database_path": str(runtime.source.job_repository.database_path),
                          "job_id": runtime.source.job_id,
                          "key": "draft.parameter_overrides.supervision_period_ms",
                          "persisted_ms": persisted_ms},
        "job_configuration": configuration, "configuration_sha256": _b_t2_digest(configuration),
        "frozen_configuration_hash": runtime._frozen_job_configuration_hash,
        "period_s": period, "period_ns": period_ns, "cursor": cursor, "due_ns": due_ns,
        "before_counter_ns": before_counter_ns, "after_counter_ns": after_counter_ns,
        "current_before": _b_t2_plain(current_before), "current_after": _b_t2_plain(current_after),
        "app_domain": _b_t2_plain(domain), "original_task_origin": origin_snapshot,
        "original_task_token": token_snapshot, "original_time": original_time,
        "hard_bounds": hard_bounds, "budget_before_reservation": budget_before,
        "owner_thread_id": owner_thread, "owner_native_thread_id": owner_native_thread,
        "source_operations": {"new_origins": 0, "renewals": 0, "extra_polls": 0,
                              "interpretation": "source-reviewed helper operations; not OS instrumentation"},
    }
    claim = runtime.reserve_supervision_capture(1, data["robot"])
    claim_publication = claim.publication
    current_publication = runtime.supervision_source_publication
    assert claim.cursor == 1
    assert claim.publication_hash == claim_publication.digest() == current_publication.digest()
    assert claim.step_id == claim_publication.checkpoint.current_step_id
    assert claim.original.digest() == data["original"].digest() == claim_publication.original_plan_hash
    assert claim.original.identity == claim_publication.identity == current_publication.identity
    observation = _b_t3_frame(runtime, key + ":supervision")
    context = SupervisionContext(
        episode_id=runtime.episode_id, plan_version=data["contract"].plan_version,
        state_version=claim_publication.state_generation, next_step_id=claim.step_id,
        next_skill=data["original"].requirements[claim.step_id].original_step.skill.value,
        task_instruction=runtime.bootstrap.definition.user_instruction,
        observation_id=observation.observation_id, captured_at=observation.captured_at,
        proprioception={"estop_engaged": False, "collision_detected": False})
    assert context.state_version == claim_publication.state_generation == current_publication.state_generation
    assert claim.cursor == 1
    cadence["supervision_context_binding"] = {
        "claim_id": claim.claim_id, "cursor": claim.cursor,
        "claim_publication_hash": claim_publication.digest(),
        "current_publication_hash": current_publication.digest(),
        "publication_state_generation": claim_publication.state_generation,
        "context_state_version": context.state_version,
    }
    runtime.complete_supervision_capture(claim, observation, context, data["robot"])
    frame = runtime.reserve_supervision_plan(claim, data["robot"])
    decision = SupervisionDecision(
        **{name: getattr(context, name) for name in (
            "episode_id", "plan_version", "state_version", "observation_id", "next_step_id")},
        recommendation="CONTINUE", reason="CPU recorded reply; no model invocation")
    completed = runtime.complete_supervision_plan(frame, decision, data["robot"])
    raw = completed.to_payload()
    assert raw["payload"]["supervisor_calls_reserved"] == 1
    assert raw["payload"]["captures_reserved"] == raw["payload"]["last_capture_cursor"] == 1
    assert raw["original_time"] == data["original"].local_time.to_payload()
    return {"record": raw, "context": context, "decision": decision, "frame": frame,
            "cadence": cadence}

def test_local_new_schema_ignores_utc_jump_but_external_does_not(monkeypatch, tmp_path, request, backend):
    from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
    from dataclasses import replace

    with _b_t2_attempt(request) as attempt:
        _b_t3_api()
        attempt["entered_behavior"] = True
        observations = []
        with _b_t2_observe(monkeypatch, attempt) as observed:
            for days in (-1, 1):
                basis = datetime.now(UTC)
                with monkeypatch.context() as shifted:
                    _b_t3_utc(shifted, basis + timedelta(days=days))

                    def exercise(runtime, session, worker, repo, job, events, reads, observed):
                        from types import SimpleNamespace
                        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision import operational_windows as windows
                        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.execution import _VisualEpisode
                        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.edge.evidence.conditions import _operational_freshness
                        from cloud_edge_robot_arm.vision.supervision import decide_supervision

                        initial = runtime.bootstrap.to_payload()
                        cap = runtime.remaining_app_seconds()
                        data = _b_t3_ground_and_route(runtime, events, backend + str(days))
                        supervisor = _b_t3_supervision(runtime, data, backend + str(days), observed)
                        reference = windows._reference_for_observation(data["observation"], "condition")
                        assert windows._check_reference(reference).status == "VALID"
                        assert windows._check_observation(data["observation"], "condition", reference=reference) is True
                        assert _operational_freshness(replace(data["online"], operational_reference=reference), 5.0) is True
                        assert windows._check_context(supervisor["context"], 5.0) is True
                        assert decide_supervision(supervisor["decision"], supervisor["context"],
                                                  supervisor["context"], maximum_age_s=5.0) == "CONTINUE"
                        forged = copy.deepcopy(reference)
                        forged["source_identity"] = "0" * 64
                        assert windows._check_reference(forged).status == "UNKNOWN"
                        assert _operational_freshness(replace(data["online"], operational_reference=forged), 5.0) is False
                        # Isolated existing B check_active method harness: no episode constructor,
                        # backend initialization, skill executor, model provider or physics call.
                        episode = object.__new__(_VisualEpisode)
                        episode.policy = SimpleNamespace(cancelled=None)
                        episode.worker_runtime = runtime
                        episode.backend = SimpleNamespace(_episode_id=runtime.episode_id)
                        episode.robot = SimpleNamespace(get_state=lambda: data["robot"])
                        episode.worker_call = lambda action: action()
                        episode.budget = runtime.verification_state
                        episode.deadline = float("inf")
                        _VisualEpisode.check_active(episode)
                        following = runtime.remaining_app_seconds()
                        assert 0 < following <= cap
                        assert runtime.bootstrap.to_payload()["original_time"] == initial["original_time"]
                        return {"utc_shift_days": days, "original_time": initial["original_time"],
                                "cap_before": cap, "cap_after": following,
                                "route": data["route"], "supervision": supervisor["record"],
                                "supervision_cadence": supervisor["cadence"],
                                "adapter_reference": reference, "external": _b_t3_external_utc(
                                    data["observation"], data["contract"], basis + timedelta(days=days)),
                                "execution_B_check_active_called": True,
                                "cap_sample_thread": threading.get_ident(), "model_calls": 0}

                    observations.append(_b_t2_exercise(shifted, tmp_path / (backend + str(days)),
                                                      backend, observed, exercise))

            def late(runtime, session, worker, repo, job, events, reads, observed):
                from cloud_edge_robot_arm.cloud.planning.models import PlannerDraft
                from cloud_edge_robot_arm.contracts import RobotState

                robot = RobotState(connected=True)
                capture = runtime.reserve_capture(robot, initial=True)
                observation = _b_t3_frame(runtime, "late-return")
                runtime.complete_capture(capture, observation, robot)
                plan = runtime.reserve_plan(robot)
                before = runtime.bootstrap.to_payload()
                owner = runtime._operational_owner
                raw = next(raw for clock, raw, domain in observed.clocks if clock is owner._clock)
                raw.now = min(hard.deadline.deadline_ns for hard in owner._hard)
                with pytest.raises((RuntimeError, ValueError), match="bound|expired|deadline|authority|live"):
                    runtime.remaining_app_seconds()
                draft = PlannerDraft(raw_text="CPU late recorded reply",
                    parsed_json={"_sentinel": "REQUEST_MORE_OBSERVATION"},
                    observation_evidence={**observation.evidence(),
                        "model_snapshot_hash": runtime.bootstrap.definition.model_snapshot_hash,
                        "role_bundle_hash": runtime.bootstrap.definition.role_bundle_hash})
                with pytest.raises((RuntimeError, ValueError), match="bound|expired|deadline|authority|live"):
                    runtime.complete_plan(plan, draft, robot)
                after = _b_t2_snapshot(events, reads)
                retained = _b_t2_retained_spend(after, before, 0)
                assert retained["payload"]["pending"]["claim_id"] == plan
                assert retained["payload"]["state"]["remaining_reobservations"] == before["payload"]["state"]["remaining_reobservations"]
                return {"hard_open_exact_ns": raw.now, "before": before,
                        "retained": retained, "after": after, "late_reply_published": False}

            observations.append(_b_t2_exercise(monkeypatch, tmp_path / (backend + "-bound"),
                                              backend, observed, late))
        _b_t3_case(tmp_path, request, "utc-provenance.json", observations, attempt)

def bounded(seconds, absolute=None):
    """Main-thread timer; nested budgets restore the earlier timer's elapsed time."""
    started = time.monotonic()
    limit = min(seconds, absolute - started) if absolute is not None else seconds
    if limit <= 0:
        raise DeadlineExpired("monotonic stage budget exhausted")
    previous_handler = signal.getsignal(signal.SIGALRM)
    previous_timer = signal.getitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL)

    def expired(signum, frame):
        raise DeadlineExpired("bounded operation exceeded %.3fs" % limit)

    signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, expired)
    inherited = previous_timer[0] if previous_timer[0] > 0 else limit
    signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, min(limit, inherited))
    try:
        yield
    finally:
        signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL, 0)
        signal.signal(signal.SIGALRM, previous_handler)
        if previous_timer[0] > 0:
            signal.setitimer(signal.ITIMER_REAL,
                             max(0.000001, previous_timer[0] - (time.monotonic() - started)),
                             previous_timer[1])

def monitor_child(process, command, data, signals, out, start, deadline):
    last_completion = start
    next_target = start
    head_deadline = start + 1.0
    next_storage = start

    def observe_head():
        nonlocal last_completion, next_target, head_deadline
        began = time.monotonic()
        budget = min(2.0, deadline - began, head_deadline - began)
        row = {"stage": "HEAD", "started_monotonic": began, "previous_completion_monotonic": last_completion,
               "completion_deadline": head_deadline, "granted_seconds": budget, "accepted": False}
        data["monitor"].append(row)
        try:
            require(budget > 0, "HEAD freshness/wall budget exhausted before observation")
            observed = git_value("rev-parse", "HEAD", timeout=budget, absolute=min(deadline, head_deadline))
            completed = time.monotonic()
            row.update(completed_monotonic=completed, gap_seconds=completed - last_completion, HEAD=observed)
            require(completed <= head_deadline and completed <= deadline, "HEAD completion exceeded deadline")
            require(observed == HEAD and not signals, "HEAD changed or wrapper interrupted")
            row["accepted"] = True
            last_completion, next_target, head_deadline = completed, completed + 0.25, completed + 1.0
        except BaseException as error:
            row.setdefault("completed_monotonic", time.monotonic())
            row.setdefault("gap_seconds", row["completed_monotonic"] - last_completion)
            row["error"] = error_record("HEAD subdeadline/observation", error)
            data["monitor_rejected"] = True
            data["timed_out"] |= time.monotonic() >= deadline
            raise

    while True:
        returncode = process.poll()
        now = time.monotonic()
        if returncode is not None:
            tail = {"stage": "observed child exit", "monotonic": now, "returncode": returncode,
                    "last_successful_HEAD_completion": last_completion, "tail_seconds": now - last_completion,
                    "HEAD_deadline": head_deadline, "accepted": now <= head_deadline and now <= deadline}
            data["monitor"].append(tail)
            data["timed_out"] |= now >= deadline
            require(tail["accepted"], "observed child exit tail exceeded HEAD/wall boundary")
            break
        if now >= deadline:
            data["timed_out"] = True
            raise DeadlineExpired("original child600s wall deadline elapsed")
        require(not signals, "TERM/INT received; enter owned cleanup")
        require(now <= head_deadline, "HEAD completion gap exceeded before next read")
        sizes = {name: (out / name).lstat().st_size for name in ("stdout.txt", "stderr.txt")}
        if any(size > RAW_CAP for size in sizes.values()):
            data["output_limited"] = True
            data["monitor"].append({"stage": "raw threshold", "monotonic": now, "bytes": sizes})
            break
        if now >= next_storage:
            observe_head()
            scan_start = time.monotonic()
            budget = min(2.0, deadline - scan_start, head_deadline - scan_start - 0.1)
            row = {"stage": "persistent live storage", "started_monotonic": scan_start,
                   "granted_seconds": budget, "deadline": scan_start + budget, "HEAD_headroom_seconds": 0.1}
            data["monitor"].append(row)
            try:
                require(budget > 0, "storage scan has no positive HEAD/wall budget")
                row["observation"] = storage_observation(command, live_sampling=True, seconds=budget,
                                                         absolute=min(deadline, head_deadline - 0.1))
                row["completed_monotonic"] = time.monotonic()
                require(row["completed_monotonic"] <= scan_start + budget, "storage scan completion overrun")
            except BaseException as error:
                row["error"] = error_record("storage subdeadline/observation", error)
                data["storage_limited"] = True
                data["timed_out"] |= time.monotonic() >= deadline
                raise
            observe_head()
            next_storage = scan_start + 5
        elif time.monotonic() >= next_target:
            observe_head()
        now = time.monotonic()
        sleep_for = min(0.1, next_target - now, head_deadline - now, deadline - now)
        if sleep_for > 0:
            time.sleep(sleep_for)
